name: Ports
description: Servers listening on this Mac — open them in a browser tab or stop them.

list.title: localhost:${port}
list.command: lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | awk 'NR>1 {n=split($9,a,":"); k=$1":"a[n]; if (!(k in s)) {s[k]=1; printf "{\"command\":\"%s\",\"pid\":\"%s\",\"port\":\"%s\"}\n", $1, $2, a[n]}}'
list.subtitle: ${command} · pid ${pid}

actions.title: Ask Agent What This Is
actions.agent: Something (${command}, pid ${pid}) is listening on port ${port}. Find out what it is and whether it belongs to this project.
